draft.briefing: Hey, you're in Jayanagar! A 2010 survey ranked it the most liveable place in Bengaluru, a neighbourhood that still keeps the old charm of the city.
draft.hungryLine: Jayanagar's 3rd and 4th Blocks are packed with food, from banana-leaf meals and biryani to some of the city's best dosas.

moodReplies.show-me-around: The Ganesha Temple in Jayanagar 4th Block is a 1 min walk, PARSEC science centre is about 7 minutes away, and the Bengaluru Art Gallery is a 9 min walk.
moodReplies.somewhere-to-chill: Lalbagh Botanical Gardens are close by, a perfect spot for a slow walk under the trees.
moodReplies.surprise-me: Just south of here, the Ragigudda to Silk Board flyover is Bengaluru's first double decker flyover, with the metro running on top of the road.

tips.title: Get to lunch early.
tips.body: Nagarjuna Chimney in Jayanagar 3rd Block always has hordes waiting at lunchtime.

tips.title: Take the Green Line.
tips.body: Jayanagar and Rashtreeya Vidyalaya Road metro stations are right in the neighbourhood, and RV Road is also an interchange for the Yellow Line.

story.title: An old corner of town
story.body: Neighbouring Thyagarajanagar is one of the oldest localities in Bengaluru, roughly 500 years old. It's dotted with temples.

story.title: A college for women
story.body: NMKRV College for Women opened in Jayanagar in 1973. Today it's co-ed and teaches arts, science and commerce.

story.title: Most liveable
story.body: A DNA Bengaluru survey ranked Jayanagar the most liveable place in the city. Its 3rd and 4th Blocks grew into busy commercial hubs while the rest stayed residential.

story.title: The metro arrives
story.body: On 18 June 2017 the Green Line stations at South End Circle, Jayanagar and Rashtreeya Vidyalaya Road opened to the public.

story.title: Yellow Line opens
story.body: The Yellow Line started running on 10 August 2025, with Rashtreeya Vidyalaya Road as its interchange. Ragigudda station on it is named after the Ragigudda Anjaneya Temple.
